title: Solo dev. No art skills. Shipped a full iOS game using AI across every stage. Here's the stack.
author: zocoi
selftext:
I built Solitaire Angel Dates, a dating sim where you unlock story scenes by winning solitaire hands. 10 characters, voice acting, 8 languages. Here's what AI did and where I still had to get my hands dirty.

**Art — Midjourney + Gemini + hand touch-up**  
AI gets 100%. It nails mood and color but can't keep a character on-model across poses. Every asset needed paintover. Still faster than learning to draw.

**Code — Cursor (Claude) + Firebase + Capacitor**  
Highest-leverage tool. I'm not a dev — AI let me build things that would've taken me months. Caution: I had to restructure twice early on the story line because I let the AI make architectural decisions I didn't fully understand. After storing story branches in JSON, I can manually verify it myself.  
  
**Writing & translation — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini**  
8 languages. Ran each through multiple models and compared. UI strings and basic dialogue are solid. Character voice and humor still need native speaker review. Tagalog and Indonesian needed the most fixing.

**Bottom line:**  
AI lowered every barrier. I still made thousands of decisions and hand-finished almost everything. It's a force multiplier, not a replacement.

**iOS:**  
[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/solitaire-classic-angel-dates/id6779414887](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/solitaire-classic-angel-dates/id6779414887)

Happy to dig into any part of the pipeline. Also any feedback on the art, story or anything to make the game better is appreciated
